The IT Administrator works closely with the Senior Security Engineer to ensure IT systems and processes support security, privacy, and compliance requirements. Partner with security personnel to implement endpoint security requirements and remediate device-related issues. Required Qualifications 3–5+ years of experience in IT administration, systems administration, corporate IT, or a similar role. Hands-on experience administering Google Workspace in a business environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in healthcare, telehealth, or another regulated environment.
